name: checks_read
description: Read checks for one target in an Origin-hosted repository: a pull request, commit, suite, or run. Rollup covers materialized check runs on the current page only and is omitted when nextPageToken is present. Does not fetch external provider logs.

owner.description: Origin namespace (owner) slug, taken from list_namespaces or an earlier Origin result. A GitHub owner or org name is not an Origin namespace unless list_namespaces returns it.

name.description: Origin repository name within that namespace
